title: huanbi
tagline: A in-world-app app decentralized exchange providing news, crypto price and games.
description: HuanBi uses a web crawler to gather daily blockchain news and utilizes the 1inch API to fetch real-time crypto prices, which are then displayed as candlestick charts. It also allows users to perform cross-chain swaps within the World App and keeps a record of wallet address transactions. Additionally, it offers a daily mini-game where users can earn crypto, helping to retain users and encourage daily engagement.
how_its_made:
1inch:
	•	History API: Retrieves the user’s wallet address transactions
	•	Charts API: Fetches real-time crypto prices

World:
	•	World Mini-App: Powered by World, this is a mini-app that can be used directly within the World App without requiring a separate download
	•	World ID: Verifies unique users to prevent repeated gameplay for earning crypto

walletconnect:
Allows users to connect their wallets using various applications like MetaMask or Coinbase, enabling the mini-app to interact with multiple blockchains
